directive.quote: Every engine job of the old Worker's rust-engine backlog rows works on the new engine, one to one or better.

preserve: an app already signed in asks for a link that works once, within WEB_SIGN_IN_SECONDS (60, now settings.json web_link_seconds)
only the hash of the link's code is kept, in a row taken once, so a used, expired or made-up link finds nothing and shows the sign-in page
the link belongs to the account whose sign-in asked for it, and nothing in the link names the account
the address it opens is decided when the link is made, by the safe return-address rule (routes::safe_next)
opening it starts a normal web session and sends the browser on with no-store
allowed_deltas: the link opens on the listed GET /sign-in route with the query field from_app instead of the old /sign-in/from-app route: the door row lists no such route, and a link that does not open falls back to that page anyway
the hold/take storage callbacks become the challenges family's insert and take
the after-sign-in choice that may put a page offering a missing way in first (goTo) is not ported: no such choice exists in the Rust sign-in yet; the link goes to its own address
the link is made through the door operation sign-in:web-link (the sign-in scope a personal key holds)
banned_substitutions: a link that names the account
an open redirect to another host
